title: This machine
summary: Your CPU, memory, load, disk and network, read from the operating system since the server started.

title: Checkout
summary: The drawing is the dashboard: six parts of a made-up service and the traffic between them. Press "start an incident", then go back and look at it.

title: An incident 18 minutes ago
summary: The same drawing over the last hour. The database slowed down 18 minutes before the server started. Drag along the bottom to watch it happen on the whole system.

group: a grid, if you want one
title: A grid of charts
summary: Nine charts in a plain grid. Shapes snap to a grid as you drag, so this is quick to draw.

title: Everything at a glance
summary: Boxes and one list. Press wall for full screen. Dark mode is one key: d.

title: Your Prometheus
summary: This drawing names a source called prom, so it fails until you declare one in .sources.json. It shows what a missing source looks like, and every word it needs.
